thread:
alex: CI red on my PR (feat/quant-opts). failing on gpu-nightly a100-sm80 job. logs show repeated kernel errors. can someone sanity check?
maria: on it. which test suite?
alex: `tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_long_sequences`
sam: saw similar locally after the cuda upgrade. full error excerpt:
```
E tensorflow: CUDA Driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime
E libcuda.so.1: undefined symbol: cuCtxGetLimit
E GPU kernel exited with XID 83 at step 423
```
jess: that feels like a driver/toolkit mismatch. which container image + cuda combo is the job using?
alex: builder: `redwood/ci-a100:cuda12.2-cudnn8.9` and node shows `+libcuda: 525.85` in dmesg.
maria: hmmm driver 525 should match cuda 12.2 but the undefined symbol and XID 83 usually point to either mismatched libcuda or a patched kernel on the host. can you paste the runner node uname and `nvidia-smi`?
alex: pasted outputs to the job artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/artefacts/1949999999/outputs.txt
(artifact snippet)
```
$ uname -a
Linux ci-runner-4 5.4.0-148-generic #161-Ubuntu SMP Mon Jan 2025 x86_64 GNU/Linux
$ nvidia-smi
NVIDIA-SMI 525.85       Driver Version: 525.85       CUDA Version: 12.2
```
sam: kernel 5.4 is older; some distributions backport stuff and the NVIDIA module could be mismatched. try rerunning on a node with kernel 5.15+ or use the legacy image pinned to driver 520 for a quick check.
maria: before full rerun, can you trigger a single failing test rerun with more logging? e.g. `pytest -k kv_cache -vv --showlocals` and set env `TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=0` to surface driver messages.
alex: done, kicked off `ci:rerun 1949999999 --target a100-sm80 --tests tests/inference/test_kv_cache.py::test_long_sequences --env TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=0`
infra-bot: Build 1949999999-rerun-1 queued on runner ci-runner-7 (kernel 5.4). Estimated start 30s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ci-runner: runner attached: ci-runner-7 (a100-40gb)
maria: if rerun still reproduces XID 83, request a bisect across driver versions. we have a helper: `infra/bisect-driver --start 520 --end 530 --job 1949999999 --tests ...`
sam: FYI I reproduced locally by downgrading the host driver to 520 and swapping the container libcuda. the failure changed from XID 83 to OOM at step 410, weird. suggests two separate regressions interacting (driver symbols + memory regression).
jess: can someone @oncall infra to check if any recent kernel module updates landed on the fleet? @maria can you ping infra? :pray:
maria: pinged infra@redwood (ticket INF-7812). they responded: "we rolled a driver build to 525.85 on a subset of CI runners yesterday; investigating parity across pool."
alex: rerun finished, still failing with XID 83. attaching log snippet:
```
2025-03-10T14:02:13Z ERROR kernel: Loaded module nvidia 525.85, but libcuda.so reports symbolic version mismatch
2025-03-10T14:02:14Z ERROR inference: launch_kernel failed: XID 83
```
sam: please escalate to bisect. add `--shrink` to narrow steps. also tag the PR so we can block merges until fix.
maria: started bisect job: `infra/bisect-driver --job 1949999999 --start 518 --end 526 --shrink --parallel 3`
infra-bot: Bisect job INF-BIS-909 submitted. running candidates 518, 520, 522, 524. updates incoming.
jess: while bisect runs, can we temporarily pin CI to driver 520 for the a100 pool to unblock PRs? ops?
maria: pre-approved by infra lead. creating a short-lived patch to pin driver tag for the a100 job. will post PR link.
alex: thanks. adding note on the PR and setting [ci/block] label.
ci-runner: Bisect progress: candidate 520 reproduced XID 83, candidate 522 passed, candidate 524 passed, candidate 518 reproduced OOM but different stack. preliminary blamelist: regression introduced between 520 and 522.
sam: looks like 520 is the culprit then. can we rollback drivers on problematic runners to 522+? or the other way: pin container to match 520?
maria: two immediate options: rollback host driver to 522 (if available), or pin container runtime to use 520-compatible libs (short term). infra prefers rollback host for consistency. filing INF-7815 for host rollback on pool subset.
jess: please add a checklist for me to follow to un-block any customer-facing deploys if needed.
maria: checklist posted in INF-7815 comment. I'll keep thread updated.
alex: appreciate the quick triage, team. i'll hold PR until green. :thumbsup:
